week_6.text:
you're running ads on 5 platforms

you have conversion tracking on 2 of them

you're flying blind on 60% of your spend

and you wonder why your ROAS numbers don't add up

what synter sets up automatically when you connect an ad account

> google ads conversion action + GTM tag
> meta CAPI with hashed email + fbclid
> linkedin CAPI with li_fat_id
> reddit CAPI with rdt_cid
> tiktok events API with ttclid
> microsoft ads with msclkid
> posthog event forwarding

all server-side, all in parallel, zero manual pixel work

shipped posthog integration yesterday

every ad conversion now fires a posthog event with full attribution data

platform, campaign, ad group, keyword, cost, click id

your product analytics and ad analytics in one place

google analytics tells you what happened

posthog tells you why

synter connects both to your ad spend so you know what to do about it

the conversion tracking stack nobody wants to build

> capture gclid, fbclid, ttclid, li_fat_id, rdt_cid, msclkid from URL params
> store in first-party cookies
> pass through signup → onboarding → purchase funnel
> fire server-side events to all 7 platforms on conversion
> deduplicate with a shared conversion_id

synter does this automatically

you just connect your accounts

how many of you have GTM containers with tags you're afraid to touch because nobody remembers who added them or why

be honest

just shipped: synter auto-publishes your GTM container after adding conversion tags

the number of people who set up google ads conversion tracking, add the GTM tag, and forget to hit publish is wild

we fixed that

ad blockers kill 30-40% of your client-side tracking events

if you're still relying on pixel-based conversion tracking in 2026 you're leaving money on the table

server-side CAPI is not optional anymore

how synter builds custom audiences from your hubspot data

> pull contact lists by lifecycle stage, deal status, or any property
> hash emails (SHA-256) for privacy compliance
> upload as custom audiences to meta, google, linkedin, tiktok
> auto-refresh weekly so your audiences stay current

retargeting your CRM segments across every platform from one command

the best custom audience isn't a lookalike

it's your hubspot contacts who visited your pricing page, didn't convert, and are now seeing your ads on meta, linkedin, and google simultaneously

that's what synter builds

saturday debugging: figured out why reddit's CAPI was silently dropping 40% of conversion events

turns out the _rdt_uuid cookie expires after 90 days but they don't tell you

server-side tracking is 80% debugging undocumented API behavior

what's the most painful ad platform to set up conversion tracking on

for me it was reddit

no documentation, no error messages, cookies that silently expire
